faq.title: A clearer path to a connected center.

items.question: Can RCMS support multiple staff roles?
items.answer: Yes. Workspaces and actions are permission-aware for administrators, receptionists, radiologists, technicians, nurses, accountants, HR teams, and other configured roles.

items.question: Does Arabic change the full interface direction?
items.answer: Yes. Switching to Arabic updates the application language, reading direction, navigation placement, spacing, and direction-sensitive controls. Your preference is remembered.

items.question: Can patients and referring physicians sign in separately?
items.answer: Yes. Dedicated portals keep patient and physician experiences focused while sharing authorized information with the center's workflow.

items.question: Will the platform fit an existing imaging workflow?
items.answer: RCMS is organized around configurable exam types, resources, roles, and integrations, so teams can adapt it to their operating model.
